                    Turn a mathematical score into real-world predictions

Probability(p)
Odds: p/(1-p) ->  Log Odds/Logit Link   ln(p/(1-p) -> B0 + B1x1
p = e^z/(1+e^z) = 1/(1+e^-z)
z = B0 + B1x1  (B is beta)

If z > 0, p > 50% risk
   z < 0, p < 50% risk
   z = 0, p = 50% risk
   
Odds = p/(1-p)
How many more times likely is it to happen than it doesn't
